title: Singapore A310 & CRJ-900 Airline Ops Arrive! NEW MSFS 2024 Marketplace Activities
description:
Looking to add purpose, structured airline schedules, and scenic VFR expeditions to your flight log in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024? The Marketplace has just expanded with brand-new activity and mission packages from Perfect Flight and Koschi, delivering structured commercial airline rotations and breathtaking bush tours across the Alps and the Baltic region! Whether you want to fly high-altitude IFR sectors across Southeast Asia in the Airbus A310, manage regional turns in the CRJ-900, or explore the newly overhauled terrain of World Update 23, this week's drop offers plenty of focused flying.

In this activity breakdown, we organize the latest marketplace arrivals into clear operational categories, review prerequisite aircraft requirements, and inspect route structures so you can choose what to load in your cockpit next:

✈️ COMMERCIAL AIRLINE & REGIONAL JET OPERATIONS
We kick things off with structured airline schedules and high-altitude IFR rotations:

A310 Captain – Singapore Airlines (by Perfect Flight): Step into the flight deck of the default iniBuilds Airbus A310-300 with an authentic Singapore Airlines livery. Fly 8 scheduled airline operations connecting Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, Hong Kong, the Philippines, and Taiwan. Flown via high-altitude airways with published SIDs and STARs, realistic managed descent requirements, over 100 dynamic in-flight events, authentic soundscapes, and comprehensive in-game briefings.

12LEGS – CRJ-900 Fall 2026 (by Perfect Flight): Take on 12 demanding regional IFR rotations across the United States between FL340 and FL390. Includes authentic regional airline liveries, multi-language pilot documentation, custom audio, and in-game briefing panels.(⚠️ Prerequisite: Requires the Aerosoft CRJ aircraft add-on, sold separately).

🏔️ SCENIC EUROPEAN VFR & BUSH EXPEDITIONS
Looking to take the low-and-slow route across newly updated regional terrain?

Baltic and Poland Discovery Tour (by Perfect Flight): A 12-leg scenic expedition designed to showcase the overhauled landscape and points of interest from World Update 23: Poland and the Baltics. Flown in the Pilatus PC-6 B2/H4 Turbo Porter (Garmin G950) or the Antonov An-28, featuring custom audio and pre-planned VFR navigation.

Poland & Baltics Part 1 (by Koschi): A dedicated multi-leg VFR bush trip taking you across Silesia, through challenging mountain passes, and over the High Tatras before routing into Warsaw. Packed with custom GPS mission support utilizing the free World Update 23 photogrammetry.

Alps and Lakes of Italy (by Koschi): A stunning scenic tour aboard the Cessna 152 tracing Northern Italy's most famous bodies of water and alpine passes. Route over Lake Maggiore, Lake Lugano, Lake Como, Bormio, Lake Garda, Trento, Cortina d'Ampezzo, and the iconic Tre Cime in the Dolomites before your final approach into Venice. Built completely on default scenery with zero external scenery dependencies.

Which of these new activities are you loading into your flight log first? Hand-flying managed descents in the Singapore A310, running regional sectors in the CRJ, or touring the Italian Alps in the 152? Let us know in the comments below!

If this marketplace breakdown helped you find your next MSFS 2024 adventure, don't forget to hit that like button, subscribe for weekly flight sim coverage, and blue skies on your next flight!
